_about: Every third-party browser asset SATOM serves. Nothing the console loads in a browser comes from another origin: an offline install on an isolated management network must render exactly like an online one. Adding or upgrading an asset: docs/engineering.md section 9.1. Enforced by tests/test_offline_assets.py.
